summary: Human was not busy. Of the 5 suite failures, Firefly catch, Flower gift, Parade party and the beach find pass on re-run alone (flaky in the full suite, state left over from earlier tests). The flora test failed consistently only because s43 added 2 field varieties (12 plots) and the test capped at 10; I raised the cap to 16 (still one instanced plot per variety).

failures.what: Four tests pass alone but fail in the full suite run: beachcomb find (Marshmallow stuck walking at the find), Firefly catch (Sprout did not walk on W), Flower gift (Wibbles did not thank), Parade party (no dance ring; followers :fish/:sleep, Sprout controlled)
failures.steps: Run the full suite after session 43 (all five of these ran late, after parade and butterfly tests), then re-run each with live_tests(pattern)
failures.expected: Same result alone and in the suite
failures.actual: Fail in the suite, pass alone: likely leftover state (a controlled Sprout, parade followers, creatures asleep or fishing) from earlier tests
